subject: Order Form audit playbook: scope clarifications & pen-test cadence
messages:
From: Alice Nguyen <alice@brightarchealth.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: security@brightarchealth.com, legal@brightarchealth.com
Date: Wed, 12 Mar 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Clarify audit scope & pen-test cadence for order form

Hi Tessa —

Thanks for sending the draft order form. Our security team had a couple of questions about the Audit Rights / Security Exhibit language before we loop legal. Quick items from our side:

- SOC 2: we want to confirm whether you provide a SOC 2 report or an attestation only. If full report, do you allow redaction of vendor-specific IP?
- Pen test: we need clarity on whether BrightArc gets a 14-day notice window for pen-test scheduling and whether tests are scoped to staging only or production in certain cases.
- Evidence cadence: your template mentions "quarterly evidence access" — our compliance folks prefer a predictable 30/60 calendar. Can we align on a cadence that supports audit deadlines?

Attached is our high-level checklist. Would you (or someone on your team) be able to propose an evidence matrix and a suggested cadence? If helpful, we can schedule a 30-min call early next week.

Best,
Alice
Director, Security & Compliance
BrightArc Health

Attachments: brightarc_checklist.pdf (stub)

From: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
To: Alice Nguyen <alice@brightarchealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 12 Mar 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarify audit scope & pen-test cadence for order form

Hi Alice —

Thanks for the clear list. Quick answers up-front and then a proposal below: 

- SOC 2: Redwood will provide the full SOC 2 Type II report for the most recent 12-month period. We routinely allow redaction of specific internal IP identifiers (e.g., CI keys) — we'll note redaction process in the exhibit.
- Pen test: default is staging-only with an option to request timeboxed production testing; requestors must provide a 14-day notice and coordinate with our SRE on maintenance windows. We can explicitly call this out and add a carveout for critical fixes.
- Evidence cadence: we can support either quarterly (rolling) access or a fixed calendar cadence (30/60/90). Suggest we map BrightArc's audit windows to a fixed quarterly calendar with a 30-day advance notice for requested evidence pulls.

Proposed next steps:
1) Internal alignment: loop legal and security (cc'd) to confirm acceptable phrasing on redaction and production carveouts.
2) I'll attach an evidence_matrix_template.xlsx and a one-page playbook text for the exhibit.
3) If that looks good, we can run a short call with your security + legal to finalize.

I've attached a first-pass redline (redlines_v1.docx) with suggested edits to the Security Exhibit. Laura — can you review the legal language for the production carveout and the indemnity linkage? Marcus — could you comment on staging vs production test controls (blast radius, rollback plan)?

Thanks — talk soon.

—Tessa
Sr. Manager, Solutions
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redlines_v1.docx (stub); evidence_matrix_template.xlsx (stub)

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 13 Mar 2025 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Order Form audit playbook: scope clarifications & pen-test cadence

Thanks Tessa. A few legal notes after a quick pass on redlines_v1: 

- SOC 2 delivery: fine to commit to providing the full report; include a clause that redactions will be limited to specific categories and documented in the exhibit. Keep the commitment timebound to the current report period and allow reasonable update cadence (annual).
- Pen-test production carveout: I recommend tightening the language so production testing requires an explicit scoped approval from Redwood legal + ops and is limited to an agreed set of endpoints; also include mandatory rollback/kill-switch requirements and a no-exfiltration clause.
- Audit rights: avoid open-ended "inspection" language. Propose: "Redwood will provide access to agreed artifacts and a named evidence package within a defined cadence, and will not be required to provide direct access to live production system consoles." That should address multi-tenant concerns.

Operational asks for the playbook: Marcus and Ops should define the staging baseline and the minimal set of evidence items we can commit without exposing internal telemetry. Marcus — can you produce a one-page staging test checklist (controls, blast radius, monitoring hooks) by Monday?

I'll draft short contract language we can insert into the Security Exhibit that preserves BrightArc's right to verify compliance while protecting Redwood's infrastructure. Ben — flag this for pricing impact if BrightArc insists on additional reporting retention beyond standard package.

Laura
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Order Form audit playbook: scope clarifications & pen-test cadence for order form

Tessa/Laura —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and thoughtful compromises. A few closure items from our side after reviewing your redlines and Laura's notes: 

1) SOC 2: BrightArc accepts Redwood's approach with redaction process. Please include a short appendix describing redaction categories and the review turnaround (5 business days).
2) Pen test: we accept staging-only as default and the production carveout language — provided there is a clear approval path and a 3rd-party assessor may be present for production tests if we request (we understand this is sensitive; we'll follow your ops review steps).
3) Evidence cadence: the fixed quarterly calendar with 30-day advance notice is workable. We'll map our audit schedule to Q1/Q3 windows — expect one evidence pull in each.

Next steps: can Priyom capture Laura's draft language into the security exhibit and send a cleaned docx back to us by Tuesday EOD? After that, we'll run a joint 30-min legal + security call to sign off. Ben — please include any pricing delta earlier flagged for additional retention.

If all agreed, happy to convert to a DocuSign-ready order form once language is finalized.

Thanks,
Alice
Director, Security & Compliance
BrightArc Health
